MacSpaces uses AppleScript for quick actions, unread counts, and media metadata from Music, Spotify, or your active browser when system-wide media info is unavailable.
MacSpaces captures audio only from apps you choose in the Audio Controls mixer so it can apply that app's saved volume or mute setting.
MacSpaces reads connection changes for your already-paired Bluetooth devices to show brief notch live activities. It does not scan for or track nearby devices.
MacSpaces shows today's events in the Calendar widget.

MacSpaces uses the camera for the notch Mirror tab so you can quickly check yourself before a call.
MacSpaces reads your Desktop to list recent screenshots in the Screenshots widget.
MacSpaces saves Voice Memo recordings to your Documents folder.
MacSpaces reads your Downloads folder to list recent files in the Downloads widget.
